summary: Boston Beer Company filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Item 5.01 covers standard director elections and an advisory vote on executive compensation, while Item 8.01 details post-meeting committee appointments. The filing discloses quorum percentages and vote tallies but no control change, no extraordinary corporate action, and no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. This is a routine current report of meeting outcomes. The summary is that no deal terms exist.
